interactions.sentence: [color=#ffffff][b]Tuan:[/b][/color] [b]Two bottles of water[/b], please. I have been delivering parcels since dawn.
[color=#ffffff][b]Tuan:[/b][/color] The woman behind the green gate sent me away. Hanh, I think. Said she had never ordered anything.
[color=#ffffff][b]Tuan:[/b][/color] The parcel had Binh's name on it. He used her address for deliveries.

response_choices: Do not leave his parcel with someone else.

interactions.sentence: [color=#ffffff][b]Tuan:[/b][/color] Right. I will keep it at the depot until someone can collect it.
[color=#ffffff][b]Tuan:[/b][/color] Thanks. I hope he turns up. It is only a box of work gloves.
